time_anchor: Spectre enters approximately one hour after opening, around 4:00 PM.
Firefight occurs shortly after Spectre enters, uses restroom, plants hard drive, and escapes.
A time jump from March 18, 2057 to May 24, 2057 is canonically appropriate.

approved_facts: Session 000 is the Siberian Wolf Incident.
The in-game date is March 18, 2057.
The real-world session date is 03/13/2026.
The Siberian Wolf opens at 3:00 PM.
Spectre enters around 4:00 PM as a nervous elf.
Spectre orders seltzer and requests restroom access.
Spectre escapes through the bathroom window before contact.
A Kestrel Defense Systems tactical retrieval team enters the Wolf aggressively to recover Spectre.
The Kestrel force consists of one captain and three enforcers in professional tactical gear.
Tension escalates into a close-quarters firefight shortly after Spectre escapes.
The Chin, Switch, Kilmer, Hubcap, and the Kestrel team are involved in the incident.
Hubcap remains concealed and fires one controlled support shot.
All Kestrel operatives are killed.
The Siberian Wolf suffers significant internal damage.
The runners avoid casualties.
The Chin organizes containment, suppresses panic, coordinates cleanup, and restores local control.
Bodies are removed, evidence is cleaned, visible traces are minimized, and the bar is stabilized.
Rumors begin in Grayline; details remain fragmented.
Session 1 begins May 24, 2057.
The March 18 to May 24 time jump explains cleanup, body disposal, repairs, and Grayline damage control.
By Session 1, the Siberian Wolf is open and operating again.
The Wolf reputation increases.
Brigada 12 presence helps stabilize the area.
Kestrel attention has been triggered but has not yet openly landed on the runners.
gm_only_facts: Spectre plants a concealed hard drive in the Wolf restroom.
The hard drive contains Kestrel project schematics.
The hard drive contains AI tactical architecture.
The hard drive contains shipment routing intelligence.
The hard drive contains manipulation evidence.
The hard drive contains operational data.
The hard drive has an embedded trace callback.
The trace callback activates when accessed.
The trace callback transmits access location.
The hard drive supports the hidden AI emergence path.
The Wolf is quietly flagged by Kestrel.
Kestrel traffic and movement review begins.
player_facing_safe_facts: A nervous elf entered the Siberian Wolf shortly after opening.
The Wolf was damaged but stabilized.
Cleanup, repairs, and damage control occurred before the next session.
